response.text_read_on_item: EPSON, EB-X27, ELPLP88, HDMI, LAN, USB-A, USB-B, Computer1, Computer2
visible_condition: no visible cracks or major physical damage
hidden_risks: lamp operating hours and remaining bulb life
functional condition of internal optics and LCD panels
whether all input ports (HDMI, VGA, USB, etc.) are working properly
presence of power cable and remote control
response.best_proof: A photo of the projector powered on displaying an image and showing the lamp hours in the settings menu
response.failure_mode: Assuming the projector is brand new or has a new lamp installed just because it is wrapped in protective plastic inside a dealer shop.
